About Couture

Fewer, better
pieces.

Couture makes everyday clothes from natural fabrics in small ateliers – and alters them for free.

Our promise

Slow fashion since 2015

We started with one tailor and a rail of linen shirts in Marylebone. The idea was simple: clothes that last ten summers, not one.

Today four small ateliers in Portugal and Italy sew for us – and our tailor still alters every piece for free.

Questions

Frequently asked

Are alterations really free?

Yes – hemming, sleeves and waist on every order, in our studio or by post.

How do sizes run?

True to size; linen relaxes slightly after the first wash.

How do I care for linen?

Wash at 30 °C, hang to dry, iron while still damp.

Which payment methods do you take?

Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay.

Do you ship abroad?

To the EU and US, 3 – 6 working days.

Can I change my order?

Within an hour – call +44 20 7946 0555.

Privacy

Your data

We use your details only for orders and, if you agree, our newsletter. Write to studio@couture.shop to delete them.
